title: Interpretable bias mitigation for textual data: Reducing gender bias in patient notes while maintaining classification performance

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring frequency differences of n-grams between male and female patient clinical notes using rank-turbulence divergence (RTD), calculating cosine similarity of terms to predefined gendered word clusters in language model embeddings (BERT), and evaluating gender classification performance degradation after applying a debiasing trimming procedure.
